title: Canone perpetuo

captions.text: ☞ The flute begins; the violin will answer it upside down.
☞ Violin: the flute's line by exact contrary motion, two bars later.
☞ The violin's mirror drops a seventh: the same intervals, a new axis.
☞ The repeat: the canon goes round again on its first axis.
☞ The third time round it stops at the fermata, the edition's Fine.

listenFor: canon by contrary motion at exact intervals

glossaryNotes.inversion: Exact contrary motion: the flute's c'' is answered by the violin's g'', two bars later; in bars 20–32, and again in bars 50–62, the mirror lies a seventh lower.
